answer: We define Sybil resistance by requiring agents to commit staking collateral to dynamic opportunity-cost bonds evaluated via a zero-knowledge verifiable delay kernel. Adversarial identity multiplication partitions this deposit, triggering a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that forces expected attack utility past the profitability mesa into strictly negative domain. Because the capital barrier scales non-linearly across the validation orchard, honest single-identity participation emerges as the unique subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium.
